name: minor heal
desc: The compassionate power of Shal'ille heals the wounds of the caster or another person.  Is particularly potent on those protected by guardian angels.  Shal'ille gives a small reward toward the karma of the mage who heals another good soul.  Requires herbs to cast.
spellIntro: Shal'ille Lv. 1: Bestows the healing touch of Shal'ille, restoring points of health.

resourceTexts.heal_cast_rsc: You are amazed to see your wounds close up and begin to heal, as if by magic.

targetNotes: 1 target, must be a User (self allowed). Refused if the target is at or above MaxHealth (heal.kod:88).
effect: Minor Heal: restores a few HP (GainHealthNormal, never above max), with a bonus for non-PK targets. The caster gains karma when healing someone with higher karma.

formulas.expr: bound(random(1,5) + (iSpellPower+1)/20 + targetKarma/20, 1, 10); + random(2,5) if the target lacks PFLAG_PKILL_ENABLE
if casterKarma < targetKarma: AddKarma(CalculateKarmaChangeFromAct(doer=casterKarma, act=targetKarma, swing=1))

messages.cast: You heal %s%s.
messages.on: You are amazed to see your wounds close up and begin to heal, as if by magic.
other: %s%s is perfectly healthy.

obtainable: true: Shal'ille level 1 (SID_MINOR_HEAL), newbie spell.
notes: Cast time 600 ms. Negative target karma can reduce the heal to the minimum of 1.

name: detect evil
desc: Allows you to see the vile defilers of her name.  Reveals all evil people and monsters that are more foul than you are pure.  Requires a fairy wing to cast.
spellIntro: Shal'ille Lv. 1: Allows you to detect evil people and monsters.

resourceTexts.DetectEvil_on_rsc: You feel more attuned to the darkness of the hearts around you.
resourceTexts.DetectEvil_off_rsc: Your eyesight returns to its former mundanity.
resourceTexts.DetectEvil_already_enchanted_rsc: You can already see the vile.
resourceTexts.DetectEvil_Success_rsc: You grant %s%s the ability to sense evil.

targetNotes: PersonalEnchantment default: self or another logged-on User; not on others in ROOM_NO_COMBAT rooms.
effect: Sets PFLAG2_DETECT_EVIL: while the viewer has karma > 0, players with karma < -10 and monsters with karma < -10 and |karma| > viewer karma are drawn flashing.

formulas.expr: selfKarma > 0 AND targetKarma(detect) < -10 AND (Player OR (Monster AND |targetKarma| > selfKarma)) -> OF_FLASHING

messages.on: You feel more attuned to the darkness of the hearts around you.
messages.off: Your eyesight returns to its former mundanity.
messages.cast: You grant %s%s the ability to sense evil.
other: You can already see the vile.

obtainable: true - Shal'ille level 1, taught by Shal'ille priest (shalprst.kod); also DetectEvilPotion
notes: Room contents resent to client on start and end.

name: holy symbol
desc: This spell involves weaving your hands in a holy tracery which frightens nearby unholy beings.  Requires elderberries to be crushed onto the skin of your hands to ritually cleanse them.
spellIntro: Shal'ille Lv. 1: Weaves a holy symbol in the air which repels any nearby undead.

resourceTexts.HolySymbol_success: Your hands weave through the air in a delicate tracery, speaking through motion the purity of Shal'ille, a ward against the unholy.

targetNotes: No targets. Affects all undead (IsUndead) non-NPC monsters in the caster's room.
effect: Each undead monster in the room rolls to be turned: on success it flees (TurnedBy) and targets the caster. On a bad failure (roll > chance+25) it chases the caster.

formulas.expr: sp*3/4 + (casterBaseMaxHealth - monsterLevel/2) + (casterKarma - monsterKarma(detect)); -5 if the monster already has a target; bound 2..98; success if random(1,100) < chance
random roll > chance + 25 -> TargetSwitch + EnterStateChase

messages.cast: Your hands weave through the air in a delicate tracery, speaking through motion the purity of Shal'ille, a ward against the unholy.

obtainable: true: Shal'ille level 1, sold by shalprst.kod.
notes: Precedence: only monsterLevel is halved (BaseMaxHealth - Level/2). GetDuration = sp/10 s is defined but unused here. Exertion 15, cast time 2 s.

name: breath of life
desc: The great power of Shal'ille takes part of the caster's life force and gives it to another person.  Requires herbs to cast.
spellIntro: Shal'ille Lv. 1: Gives part of caster's health to another person.

resourceTexts.breathoflife_cast_rsc: You feel the life force of another filling your body.
resourceTexts.breathoflife_caster_msg_rsc: You give part of your life force to %s%s.
resourceTexts.breathoflife_unnecessary_rsc: %s%s cannot handle additional life force from this spell.
resourceTexts.breathoflife_toohurt_rsc: You do not have enough health to transfer to another!
resourceTexts.breathoflife_notonself_rsc: You cannot cast Breath of Life on yourself.

targetNotes: 1 target, must be a User, not self. The caster needs Health > 10. The target must have Health < 1.5*MaxHealth and < 130, and not (Health >= MaxHealth while marked with MarkOfDishonor) (brthlife.kod:103-121).
effect: Transfers a karma-dependent share of the caster's current health to another player. The target may exceed max health up to 150% (hard cap 130).

formulas.expr: pct = bound(targetKarma,10,80); loss = casterHealth*pct/100, capped at casterHealth-10
transfer = loss*(75 + iSpellPower/2)/100, capped at 1.5*targetMax - targetHealth and at 130 - targetHealth; sp99 = 124% of loss

messages.cast: You give part of your life force to %s%s.
messages.on: You feel the life force of another filling your body.
other: %s%s cannot handle additional life force from this spell.
You do not have enough health to transfer to another!
You cannot cast Breath of Life on yourself.

obtainable: true: Shal'ille level 1, sold by shalprst.kod.
notes: Uses LoseHealth on the caster and GainHealth (not GainHealthNormal) on the target, which allows overheal. The percentage uses the TARGET's karma.

name: seance
desc: Shal'ille's magic allows communication with the spirit world to reveal the location of the last person to slay an innocent.  Requires herbs to cast.
spellIntro: Seance_spell_intro_rsc

resourceTexts.Seance_No_Murderer_rsc: There is no murderer to be hunted.
resourceTexts.Seance_I_See_You_rsc: You sense that someone is aware of your whereabouts.
resourceTexts.Seance_Cloaked_Target_rsc: Qor's dark magic has diverted an enemy's attention.
resourceTexts.Seance_casting_rsc: You appeal to Shal'ille for knowledge of %s%s's whereabouts.
resourceTexts.Seance_Target_Location_rsc: You sense that %s%s can be found somewhere around %s.
resourceTexts.seance_spell_intro_rsc: Shal'ille Lv. 1: Gives a chance of knowing the location of the last person to have committed murder.

targetNotes: No target. Requires a 'last murderer' (SYS GetLastMurderer) who is logged on and not a non-huntable DM. Not castable in HappyLand.
effect: Tells the caster the room where the last murderer is; on failure or if the murderer is cloaked, gives a false room and keeps repeating it for a while.

formulas.expr: bound(sp/2 + karma/3 + bound(maxHP,1,100)/4, 15, 99) % (immortal DM: 100)
random(1,100) > chance OR (killer has Cloak AND random(1,100) < cloakState)
D = bound(300 - (7*sp/5 + karma), 60, 300) s; random(D/2, D) - but called with #spellpower so sp=0 -> bound(300-karma,60,300)

messages.cast: You appeal to Shal'ille for knowledge of %s%s's whereabouts.
other: You sense that %s%s can be found somewhere around %s.
There is no murderer to be hunted.
You sense that someone is aware of your whereabouts. (to murderer on success)
Qor's dark magic has diverted an enemy's attention. (to cloaked murderer)

obtainable: true - Shal'ille level 1
notes: While the caster has the seance enchantment (no icon), every cast returns the stored false room name. Bug: GetDuration parameter name mismatch (#spellpower vs iSpellPower).

name: holy touch
desc: Pure energy from Shal'ille sears your target.  More effective on evil and undead targets.   Requires emeralds.
spellIntro: Shal'ille Lv. 2: Delivers the judgment of Shal'ille in your touch.

resourceTexts.HolyTouch_already_enchanted_rsc: Your hands are already bathed in Shal'ille's love.
resourceTexts.HolyTouch_On_rsc: Your hands are bathed in Shal'ille's love.
resourceTexts.HolyTouch_Off_rsc: Your hands are no longer bathed in Shal'ille's love.
resourceTexts.HolyTouch_player_was_hit: %s%s scalds you with the pure force of Shal'ille!
resourceTexts.HolyTouch_player_hit_something: %s%s%s shrinks away from the pure energy of Shal'ille.
resourceTexts.HolyTouch_player_killed_something: %s%s finally succumbs, finding peace through Shal'ille's purifying energy.
resourceTexts.HolyTouch_player_was_killed: The touch of %s%s separates body from soul and sends you to the underworld.

targetNotes: Self enchantment (vbCanCastOnOthers FALSE). Casting removes any other TouchAttackSpell enchantment.
effect: Turns the caster's melee/punch attacks into holy touch strokes (range 2) whose damage depends on spellpower, doubled against undead and scaled by the victim's karma.

formulas.expr: d = random(3,6); d = d/2 + (d/2*sp)/99 + 1; undead: *2; else d + (-karma)*d/200 (karma -100..100 -> x1.5..x0.5); min 1
proficiency = max(Punch skill, 1.5*Mysticism); stroke = holy touch spell ability; viHit_Factor 15

messages.on: Your hands are bathed in Shal'ille's love.
messages.off: Your hands are no longer bathed in Shal'ille's love.
other: Your hands are already bathed in Shal'ille's love.
%s%s scalds you with the pure force of Shal'ille!
%s%s%s shrinks away from the pure energy of Shal'ille.
%s%s finally succumbs, finding peace through Shal'ille's purifying energy.
The touch of %s%s separates body from soul and sends you to the underworld.

obtainable: true - Shal'ille level 2
notes: Attack type ATCK_WEAP_UNARMED+PUNCH plus spell ATCK_SPELL_HOLY+ALL; can be blocked/parried/dodged; stroke STROKE_HOLY_TOUCH. Each touch uses spell's ability improvement (ImproveStroke).

name: remove curse
desc: Breaks the magical bond binding you to a cursed item.  Requires emeralds to cast.
spellIntro: Shal'ille Lv. 2: Breaks the magical bond binding you to a cursed item.

resourceTexts.RemoveCurse_on: Shal'ille tears the cursed item from your body.
resourceTexts.RemoveCurse_bad_target: Shal'ille detects no accursed items to strip away.

targetNotes: 1 target, must be a Player currently using a cursed item (IsCursedByItems) (remcurse.kod:65-93).
effect: Unwields/removes all cursed items the target is using (they stay in inventory).

messages.on: Shal'ille tears the cursed item from your body.
other: Shal'ille detects no accursed items to strip away.
spell_cast_on_target (caster, if different target)

obtainable: true - Shal'ille level 2, enabled; also potion
notes: Does not remove the curse attribute itself; uses player.kod:9928 RemoveCurseAllItems (UnuseItem). No spellpower dependence.

name: cure poison
desc: Pure, healing energy fights the effects of poison in the target.  Requires herbs and elderberries to cast.
spellIntro: Shal'ille Lv. 2: Fights the effects of any poisons which may flow through the target's body.

resourceTexts.curepoison_on: The power of Shal'ille fights the effects of poison in your blood.
resourceTexts.curepoison_abates: You feel the poison grow weaker.

targetNotes: Exactly 1 target, must be a User (:76) and must currently be enchanted with Poison (SID_POISON) (:84-90).
effect: Either removes the poison enchantment entirely or reduces its strength (loss rate) by spellpower percent and re-applies it with the remaining time.

formulas.expr: after = lossRate - lossRate*sp/100

fully removed if random(1,100) < sp OR lossRate <= 100 OR after < lossRate/10 OR after < 100; else poison restarted with state=after, same remaining time, plus AddPoison(strength=after, bVigorLoss=FALSE)

messages.cast: You cast %s on %s%s.
messages.on: The power of Shal'ille fights the effects of poison in your blood.
other: %s%s is not suffering from poison.
You feel the poison grow weaker.

obtainable: true - Shal'ille lvl 2, taught by shalprst; reagents Herbs 2, Elderberry 1
notes: Uses only the first Poison enchantment found (GetEnchantmentsByClass &Poison). Potion: CurePoisonPotion.

name: holy weapon
desc: Dedicates your weapon to Shal'ille, enhancing its effectiveness against the unholy.  Requires fairy wings and orc teeth to cast.
spellIntro: Shal'ille Lv. 2: Dedicates your  weapon to Shal'ille, enhancing its effectiveness against the unholy.

resourceTexts.holyweapon_cast_rsc: Your %s is now dedicated to Shal'ille.
resourceTexts.holyweapon_fails: The %s is strangely unaffected by the spell.
resourceTexts.holyweapon_already_done: This weapon is already dedicated to Shal'ille.

targetNotes: 1 target that must be a Weapon, held by caster or lying in the caster's room (IsTargetInRange override); fails if weapon already has ATCK_SPELL_HOLY or CanEnchant(oSpell) is false. Cast time 30000 ms.
effect: Adds a timed weapon attribute WA_ATTACKSPELLTYPE with ATCK_SPELL_HOLY to the weapon so its hits count as holy damage (extra vs. holy-vulnerable/undead monsters per their resistance tables).

formulas.expr: (random(1,4) + iSpellPower/3) hours. sp1: 1-4 h, sp99: 34-37 h

messages.cast: Your %s is now dedicated to Shal'ille.
other: You cannot dedicate %s%s to Shal'ille.
This weapon is already dedicated to Shal'ille.

obtainable: true - Shal'ille priest (temples/shalprst.kod)
notes: State3 = GetMakerInfo(caster). holyweapon_fails resource unused. CastSpell rechecks range; uses generic spell_resists msg if CanEnchant fails.

name: resist acid
desc: Coats your body in a magical goo which absorbs damage from acid attacks for several minutes.  Requires herbs and entroot berries.
spellIntro: Shal'ille Lv. 2: Coats your body in a magical goo which absorbs damage from acid attacks.

resourceTexts.ResistAcid_already_enchanted: You are already resistant to acid spells.
resourceTexts.ResistAcid_on: A chalky goo oozes out your pores and coats your entire body.
resourceTexts.ResistAcid_off: The blessed goo bubbles away as the resist acid enchantment wears off.
resourceTexts.ResistAcid_Success: A chalky goo oozes out of %s%s's pores and coats their entire body.

targetNotes: PersonalEnchantment: 1 target, a User (or any target when cast from an item). Cannot buff others in ROOM_NO_COMBAT rooms. Fails if already enchanted (unless the server allows self recast).
effect: Adds acid resistance (AddResistance(-ATCK_SPELL_ACID, value)) for several minutes and removes it on expiry.

formulas.expr: iSpellPower/2 + 15 (15..64)

messages.cast: A chalky goo oozes out of %s%s's pores and coats their entire body.
messages.on: A chalky goo oozes out your pores and coats your entire body.
messages.off: The blessed goo bubbles away as the resist acid enchantment wears off.
other: You are already resistant to acid spells.

obtainable: true: Shal'ille level 2 (teacher reference). Also ResistAcidPotion.
notes: The resistance value is stored as the enchantment state and subtracted again in EndEnchantment (resist.kod:47-55,80-91).

name: rescue
desc: Calls upon Shal'ille to transport you back to safety.  Ability determines how fast you are rescued.  Requires emerald to cast.
spellIntro: One of the many mystical spells.

resourceTexts.Rescue_Success: You feel a holy force rescue you from your current situation.
resourceTexts.Rescue_Token_Cancel: You cannot rescue while holding a token.

targetNotes: Self (0 targets). Fails if caster attacked a player within the last TeleportAttackDelaySec (600 s), holds a Token, or a rescue timer already runs. Banned in arenas.
effect: After a delay, teleports the caster to safety: own guild hall (if same region), Ko'catan inn (in Ko'catan region / Pool of Vigor), Pool of Vigor (orc caves), else hometown (AdminGoToSafety).

messages.cast: You start your rescue preparations.
messages.on: You feel a holy force rescue you from your current situation.
other: You are already being rescued.
You cannot rescue while holding a token.

obtainable: true - Shal'ille priest (shalprst.kod)
notes: Timer ptRescue on player; cancelled on death, logoff, delete, picking up a token (player.kod:1011,1920,7800; token.kod:258). Not executed if in RID_OUTOFGRACE. Potion RescuePotion.

name: cure disease
desc: Pure, healing energy purges disease from the target.  Requires herbs and elderberries to cast.
spellIntro: One of the many mystical spells.

resourceTexts.curedisease_on: The power of Shal'ille burns the disease from your body.
resourceTexts.curedisease_abates: You feel the disease grow weaker.

targetNotes: Exactly 1 target, must be a User currently enchanted by any &Disease class enchantment; otherwise spell_bad_target.
effect: Chance to remove all diseases; otherwise weakens Palsy and Dementia by restoring a spellpower-percentage of their stat loss.

formulas.expr: random(1,100) < iSpellPower -> RemoveEnchantmentClass(&Disease)
newLoss = loss - loss*sp/100; if newLoss > 2: AddMight(loss-newLoss) and store newLoss; else remove Palsy
same formula with AddIntellect

messages.cast: The power of Shal'ille burns the disease from your body.
other: You feel the disease grow weaker.

obtainable: true - Shal'ille level 3; also CureDiseasePotion
notes: Partial path only handles Palsy and Dementia; other Disease subclasses untouched unless the full-cure roll succeeds. Modifies the enchantment state list in place via SetNth.

name: hospice
desc: Rejuvenates the target of the spell with Shal'ille's healing energy.  Shal'ille gives a small reward toward the karma of the mage who heals another good soul.  Requires herbs to cast.
spellIntro: One of the many mystical spells.

resourceTexts.hospice_cast_rsc: The spirit of Shal'ille enters your body and rejuvenates it.

targetNotes: 1 target that must be a User; fails if target is at full health.
effect: Heals the target; the caster gains karma if he heals someone with higher karma.

formulas.expr: bound(random(-3,3) + iSpellPower/5 + targetKarma/10, 0, 25) via GainHealthNormal
if caster != target and casterKarma < targetKarma: AddKarma(CalculateKarmaChangeFromAct(doer=casterKarma, act=targetKarma, swing 2))

messages.cast: You heal %s%s.
messages.on: The spirit of Shal'ille enters your body and rejuvenates it.
other: %s%s is perfectly healthy.

obtainable: true - Shal'ille level 3, sold by Tos apothecary (TsApoth.kod)
notes: Evil targets (karma -100) heal 0..~10 even at high spellpower. Cast time 600 ms.

name: holy resolve
desc: Shal'ille is summoned to fortify the soul against unholy damage.  Requires solagh and fairy wings to cast.
spellIntro: Shal'ille Level 1: Protects you from damage from unholy sources.

resourceTexts.resistevil_on: You feel a warm presence fortifying your defense against evil.
resourceTexts.resistevil_off: You feel chilled as the fortifying spirit of Shal'ille departs.

targetNotes: PersonalEnchantment on a User; not if already enchanted.
effect: Holy Resolve: adds resistance against unholy spell damage (resistance type -ATCK_SPELL_UNHOLY).

formulas.expr: sp/2 + 15 (15..64) added via AddResistance(-ATCK_SPELL_UNHOLY)

messages.on: You feel a warm presence fortifying your defense against evil.
messages.off: You feel chilled as the fortifying spirit of Shal'ille departs.
messages.cast: You fortify %s%s against evil.
other: You already have holy resolve.

obtainable: true - Shal'ille lvl 3, taught by kcbonepr (Ko'catan); reagents Solagh 1, FairyWing 1
notes: Not offered to new characters (island spell). Resistance value stored as state and removed with RemoveResistance.

name: identify
desc: Reveals any special properties of an item to the caster.  Requires orc teeth to cast.
spellIntro: One of the many mystical spells.

resourceTexts.identify_cant: You can't seem to gain a proper focus on %s%s.

targetNotes: 1 Item target with CanIdentify TRUE; must be held by caster or in same room (IsTargetInRange override). Cast time 15000 ms.
effect: Shows the caster a full look description of the item including hidden item attributes (temporarily reveals then re-hides them if not yet identified).

messages.cast: You concentrate on %s%s and see...
other: You can't seem to gain a proper focus on %s%s.

obtainable: true - faction NPCs (factions/rebel.kod, towns/wanderer/jGeneral.kod)
notes: ResetReagents does not clear plReagents first (cons onto existing list) - possible duplicate reagent bug on reset.

name: spiritual hammer
desc: Materializes a spiritual hammer.  Requires emeralds and orc teeth to cast.
spellIntro: One of the many mystical spells.

resourceTexts.createspiritualhammer_inv_full_rsc: A spiritual hammer appears in the air before you, but before you can drop something and grab it, it vanishes.

targetNotes: No targets; item is put into caster's inventory if ReqNewHold allows (:85).
effect: Creates a temporary SpiritualHammer weapon (bludgeon, high quality, holy attack flag, never takes wear) in the caster's inventory with a to-hit bonus; it deletes itself when its timer expires.

formulas.expr: (10 + 50*sp/100) minutes -> ms; sp1: 10 min, sp99: 59 min
iToHitBonus = sp*3/2 (added to hit roll in SpiritualHammer.ModifyHitRoll)

messages.cast: A spiritual hammer appears.
messages.off: Your spiritual hammer disappears in a puff of smoke!
other: A spiritual hammer appears in the air before you, but before you can drop something and grab it, it vanishes.

obtainable: true - Shal'ille lvl 3, taught by shalprst; reagents Emerald 2, OrcTooth 1
notes: Hammer sets ATCK_SPELL_HOLY flag (spirhamm.kod Constructor). WeaponHitTarget overridden so it never degrades. Off message comes from the item (spirhamm.kod:25).

desc: The spirit of Shal'ille calls upon her ally Faren, forming a truce with creatures of nature for several minutes.  Requires emerald and yrxl sap to cast.
spellIntro: One of the many mystical spells.

resourceTexts.truce_on: A numbing calm settles upon your mind. You find yourself unable to lift a weapon against nature.
resourceTexts.truce_off: The calm that had gripped your mind departs.  You feel ready for battle once more.
resourceTexts.truce_no_towns: Shal'ille does not permit you to interfere right now.

name: forces of light
desc: Summons Shal'ille to infuse her power into all good players in the room, making their attacks more accurate and her spells more potent.  Requires elderberries and emeralds to cast.
spellIntro: One of the many mystical spells.

resourceTexts.forcesoflight_already_enchanted: This place is already infused with the spirit of Shal'ille.
resourceTexts.forcesoflight_on: This place is infused with the spirit of Shal'ille.
resourceTexts.forcesoflight_off: The spirit of Shal'ille departs from this place.
resourceTexts.forcesoflight_player_on: You are filled with the spirit of Shal'ille.
resourceTexts.forcesoflight_player_off: The spirit of Shal'ille has left you.

targetNotes: Caster's room; fails if room already has it. RoomEnchantment.DoubleCheckAfterTrance (only blocks harmful/outlaw spells in no-combat rooms - this one is neither).
effect: Room enchantment: every occupant with positive karma (checked on start/entry) gets an attack modifier (+hit roll); Shal'ille spells cast in the room get extra spellpower.

messages.cast: This place is infused with the spirit of Shal'ille.
messages.off: The spirit of Shal'ille departs from this place.
messages.on: You are filled with the spirit of Shal'ille.

name: mark of dishonor
desc: Allows caster to cast Shal'ille's displeasure upon a target.  Will prevent target's life force from exceeding the body's maximum.  For evil targets, Shal'ille will cause a loss of vigor.  Requires emeralds to cast.
spellIntro: One of the many mystical spells.

resourceTexts.MarkOfDishonor_start: Shal'ille singles you out for punishment.  Your life energies ebb.
resourceTexts.MarkOfDishonor_stop: Shal'ille's attention turns to more pressing matters.
resourceTexts.MarkOfDishonor_success: The eyes of Shal'ille turn towards %s%s.
resourceTexts.MarkOfDishonor_no_self: You cannot cast mark of dishonor upon yourself; if you were truly dishonorable you would not be able to cast Shal'ille's spells.

targetNotes: Exactly 1 target, Player or Monster, not self, not already marked (dishonor.kod:80-129). Harmful+outlaw, viNoNewbieOffense, not castable in HappyLand (safe areas).
effect: On an evil (negative karma) player: drains 20 vigor and lowers their vigor rest threshold proportionally to how evil they are, for the duration. On a monster: forces it to target and attack the caster.

formulas.expr: if karma<0: change = karma*(threshold - 10)/MAX_EVIL(-100) = |karma|*(threshold-10)/100; clamp so threshold-change >= 10; threshold -= change (restored +change at end). Default threshold 80 (player.kod:891), bound 10..100
AddExertion(200000) (exertion 10000 = 1 vigor -> ~20 vigor)
players: (120 + 4*iSpellPower) s (124 s .. 516 s); monsters: GetDuration called without spellpower -> 120 s
TargetSwitch(caster, iHatred=1000) + EnterStateAttack

messages.cast: The eyes of Shal'ille turn towards %s%s.
messages.on: Shal'ille singles you out for punishment.  Your life energies ebb.
messages.off: Shal'ille's attention turns to more pressing matters.
other: %s%s appears more lethargic. (to caster when target karma<0)
